subject: part
title: (R)PART.------POL.DY.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 333 (PCC-17). PART (participation) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". The title names POL-DY (political dynamics); the chart has no label for it. From the subject: POL-DYM (political dynamics) and RT-DY (reality dynamics). From RT-DY: PROG-SIGN (progressional significance). From PROG-SIGN: ACC-DY (accelerated dynamics) and INFO-DS (information dissemination). From INFO-DS: EXP-DYM (expansion dynamics) and ALT-C-PG (alternative composite progressionalism). From EXP-DYM: EXP-INFO-B (expansion information basis).
